details.description: Azure Speech's neural text-to-speech HD voices are a higher-quality voice tier within Microsoft's Azure AI Foundry Tools, built on large speech-generation base models called DragonHD and Dragon HD Omni. DragonHD offers more than 30 professionally fine-tuned voice personas, while Dragon HD Omni expands to 700+ voices with automatic emotion detection and multilingual support. Both automatically adjust tone and prosody to match the sentiment of the input text and stream with under-300ms real-time latency.
advantages: Automatically detects emotion in input text and adjusts speaking tone and prosody in real time, without manual SSML tuning.
Dragon HD Omni offers more than 700 voices, including 300+ AI-generated personas, with automatic multilingual language detection.

Supports dozens of expressive style and paralinguistic tags (e.g. excited, whispering, sighing, laughter) via SSML or inline bracket tags, and Dragon HD Omni adds automatic style prediction from natural-language descriptions with more than 100 styles for the Ava and Andrew personas.
Real-time synthesis latency is under 300 ms, faster than Azure OpenAI's HD voices (greater than 500 ms) per Microsoft's own comparison table.
Dragon HD Omni supports word boundary events for precise word-level timing, useful for karaoke-style captioning and synchronized applications.
disadvantages: HD voices support real-time synthesis only; unlike Azure's standard neural voices, they do not support batch/asynchronous synthesis.
HD voices support only a subset of SSML elements (e.g. no <prosody> or <emphasis>) that Azure's standard neural voices support in full.
Some DragonHD voices, including Andrew3, Ava3, and the MultiTalker Ava-Andrew persona, are still in preview.
use_cases: Enterprise customer service voice applications requiring a consistent persona
Conversational voice assistants and interactive agents
Content creation requiring a wide variety of voice personas

sources.title: What are neural text to speech HD voices? - Foundry Tools | Microsoft Learn

notes: This catalog entry (azure/speech/azure-tts-hd) covers Azure's HD voice tier (DragonHD and Dragon HD Omni) as a group. The languages list reflects the locales explicitly named in the DragonHD voice table; Dragon HD Omni supports broader multilingual output via automatic language detection but the source gives only a voice count (700+), not a language list, for that model. The source's fixed SSML/bracket style-tag list totals under 70 tags for either model; the 'more than 100 styles' figure is specific to Dragon HD Omni's separate natural-language automatic style prediction feature on the Ava and Andrew personas, not the tag list, so the advantage sentence was corrected to avoid conflating the two.
